events.name: [In-Person] KCD Rejecteds @ Cloud Native Kuala Lumpur Meetup - September 2026
events.description: **This is a free event, but RSVP is required!** Join us for the in-person September 2026 edition of Cloud Native Kuala Lumpur Meetup! This time with the theme **KCD Rejecteds** **Giveaway**: Wear your KCD Kuala Lumpur t-shirt and join us at the meetup in-person to be part of the lucky draw for free CNCF certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS, etc.) **KCD Rejecteds** is inspired by **[Cloud Native Rejekts](https://cloud-native.rejekts.io) (part of KubeCon)**, where "Rejekts" (and in our case "Rejecteds") is a playful community term (not a negative label) that celebrates giving great talks another opportunity to be shared. It offers a community-first stage **for talks that weren't selected for the main KCD Kuala Lumpur 2026 event**, while welcoming diverse perspectives and fostering learning, collaboration, and innovation in the cloud native community. Whether you are a software developer, SRE, cloud engineer or just interested in cloud native (and open source) concepts, this meetup is perfect for you. This is also a great opportunity to network and connect with other professionals in the industry who are also passionate about cloud native. Don't miss out on the chance to learn from industry experts and discuss the latest advancements in cloud computing, software security, and more. RSVP now and secure your spot for the meetup! **NOTE**: **To avoid duplication, please RSVP only once, either here in [meetup.com](https://www.meetup.com/cloud-native-kuala-lumpur/events/315626801) or at the [OCG page](https://ocgroups.dev/cncf/group/cloud-native-kuala-lumpur/event/59cs28d). And RSVP "yes" only if you're able to attend the meetup in-person. If you've RSVP-ed "yes" and couldn't make it to the meetup, please revert the RSVP to "no"** **Date**: September 2nd, 2026 (Wednesday) **Time**: 6pm - 9.30pm **Venue**: AWS @ The Gardens North Tower **Food Sponsor**: KCD (Kubernetes Community Days) Kuala Lumpur **Agenda** **6.00pm**: Arrival + Food **7.15pm**: Welcome note **7.30pm**: Rejecteds Talk #1: Observability with eBPF + OpenTelemetry **8.00pm**: Lightning Talk: How to Secure CNCF Travel Funding / Scholarship for KubeCon? **8.10pm**: Rejecteds Talk #2: Sovereign Kubernetes Business Continuity with Velero **8.40pm**: Quiz + Giveaway **Session Details (Talk #1)** **Speaker Bio**: **Chatwin Hoe** is a Senior Sales Engineer at Datadog, covering the Malaysian market, working with platform and engineering teams on observability across cloud native environments. Previously an Observability Solutions Architect at Splunk, Chatwin is drawn to the practical side of the field — what instrumentation actually costs a team to adopt and maintain, and where kernel-level visibility fills the gaps. **Session Title**: Observability with eBPF + OpenTelemetry **Session Description:** Kubernetes is hard to observe: pods are ephemeral, symptoms cross multiple layers, and instrumenting a workload you don't own means a ticket and someone else's sprint. **eBPF** removes that constraint. Every service lands on the map with its request, error and latency signals, in any language, plus the connection-level detail between pods. No code changes, no sidecars, no sign-off. The session concludes by examining the limits of eBPF and its relationship with OpenTelemetry: eBPF provides breadth across every workload, while OpenTelemetry contributes the application-level depth the kernel cannot observe **Session Details (Talk #2)** **Speaker Bio**: **Arun Kumar** is the Head of Cloud and Data Engineering at Nimbus Cloud Sdn Bhd **Session Title**: Sovereign Kubernetes Business Continuity with Velero **Session Description:** Sovereign Kubernetes platforms deployed on-prem must operate without relying on hyperscaler-managed k8s services. In such environments, business continuity must be engineered using open, self-hosted cloud-native tooling. This session demonstrates a production-ready disaster recovery implementation using Velero integrated with S3-compatible object storage in an on-prem sovereign setup. Rather than focusing only on commands, this talk walks through the complete lifecycle: * Designing the backup storage architecture * Configuring Velero with S3-compatible storage * Scheduling incremental backups * Simulating a failure scenario * Executing a controlled restore into a target cluster * Protecting backup storage during disaster mode

events.description: Good day everyone! We're meeting at Padi Malaya, Gourmet Street, Ground Floor, G 12b, Lalaport, BBCC. Same relaxed crowd, same great drinks and food, do feel free to bring your friends along for a night of good conversation and good food. I do look forward to seeing you all there! For your benefit, here are some Frequently Asked Questions: Q. What is the agenda of this monthly Malaysia Entrepreneur gathering? A. Being an entrepreneur can be a lonely journey so this is meetup where you can bounce ideas and get feedback from your peers. Try not to bore the other party with the history of your business. Focus on educating each other and building relationships. Q. Is this a free to attend event? A. Attendees have to pay the venue for the food/drinks you consume. You won't be allowed to join us if you don't order anything. Q. I am not an entrepreneur/I am a student/I am thinking of becoming an entrepreneur/I am a government worker/I am a corporate worker/etc. Am I still allowed/able to come for the event? A. Sure! Q. I have this marvelous new method of making money the easy and fast way via Multi-Level Marketing/Personal Franchising/insert-other-similar-names... A. PLEASE DO NOT TURN UP AND HARASS OUR ATTENDEES. And NO, I do not intend to answer your questions "why/what is wrong/why are you so closed minded/why are you etc etc". Q. I have this great idea! But why don't you do it for me? A. Malaysia Entrepreneurs Network is a volunteer driven initiative. We are under no obligation to do anything for you, and neither are my fellow co-organizers. That said, we welcome whoever wishes to organize an event series as long as you have commitment in running the events. EXTRA NOTE 1. No hard selling, don't pester or force people to buy/join 2. Don't over sell yourself, company or product. Ex: Introducing your company or product yes for 2-3 minutes is acceptable, but not if you keep going on about it for 1 hour+ 3. Not welcomed: Snake oil (Miracle) schemes not allowed (ex: xxx product that can cure AIDS, Cancer, makes you immortal/god, product that can guarantee to make you a millionaire if you invest xxx) 4. Not welcomed: All investment `schemes` are not allowed (ex: I represent a marketing company in Singapore selling Sugar investment by this firm in UK who is own by a group of VC in Hong Kong). Finding investors for YOUR company, or looking to invest = ok 5. Not welcomed: Medically insane people 6. You WILL be asked to leave if you fall into #3-#5

events.description: # AI Salon KL: When A.I. Meets Financial Crime *** ​🚀 AI is transforming every industry – but it's also transforming crime. ​From AI-generated scams and deepfake fraud to increasingly sophisticated financial crime networks, artificial intelligence is reshaping both how crimes are committed and how organizations respond. Behind many of today's large-scale scam operations are complex human trafficking networks, raising urgent ethical, regulatory, and societal questions. ​Join us for the next edition of AI Salon KL as we bring together experts in AI ethics, financial crime, law, fintech, and compliance to examine how AI is reshaping both financial crime and the fight against it. ​Together, we'll explore how AI is changing the tactics used by criminals, the new challenges facing financial institutions and regulators, and what startups, enterprises, governments, and the AI community can do to build technology responsibly. ​Expect practical insights, thought-provoking discussion, and meaningful conversations with Kuala Lumpur's growing AI community. ## ​🎤 Panel: AI Ethics & Financial Crime ​We're excited to welcome an outstanding panel of experts working at the intersection of AI, ethics, compliance, finance, and law: ​\*\*[Adam R. Khan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adam-r-khan/?utm_source=luma)\*\* Co-author, *[FullStack AI Ethicist](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GW3X38S9?utm_source=luma)* ​Adam is an AI ethics researcher, educator, and author focused on responsible AI, governance, and regulatory compliance. As co-author of *FullStack AI Ethicist*, he works to help organizations understand the ethical and practical considerations of deploying AI responsibly in an increasingly regulated world. ​\*\*[Ruben Tan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rubentan/?utm_source=luma)\*\* Tech Co-Founder, Atomycal ​Ruben has spent years helping fintech companies build and scale secure payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia. Drawing from his experience designing financial systems, he'll share perspectives on the evolving fraud landscape, the security challenges introduced by AI, and how financial platforms are adapting to increasingly sophisticated threats. ​\*\*[Sandhya Nair Vijian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sandhya-nair-vijian-3bb86212/?utm_source=luma)\*\* Founder & Managing Director, Enhance QC ​Sandhya is a financial crime compliance specialist and founder of Enhance QC, a training provider focused on anti-money laundering (AML), financial crime compliance, governance, and risk management. She works with financial institutions and professionals to strengthen capabilities in identifying and combating emerging financial crime risks. ​**Moderated by:** **[Audrey Aui Yong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/audreyaui/?utm_source=luma)** CEO, Tsuin AI ​Together, they'll discuss: * ​How AI is changing the landscape of financial crime and fraud * ​AI-powered scams, deepfakes, and the next generation of social engineering * ​The connection between AI-enabled financial crime and global scam centres * ​Human trafficking and the hidden infrastructure behind organized cybercrime * ​AI ethics, governance, and responsible AI deployment * ​What startups, enterprises, financial institutions, and policymakers should be doing today * ​Audience Q&A ​Expect a candid, multidisciplinary discussion exploring both the opportunities and risks created by the rapid advancement of AI. *** ## ​🎤 Startup / Builder Demo Opportunities ​As tradition, we're opening a limited number of demo slots for founders, researchers, and builders to showcase their AI products during the event. ​Whether you're building AI agents, developer tools, enterprise software, infrastructure, robotics, healthcare AI, or any applied AI solution, we'd love to hear from you. ​Let us know in the registration form if you'd like to demo your project. ​Selected teams will have the opportunity to present their work to the AI Salon community. *** ## ​📅 Event Details ​**Date:** Tuesday 22 September 2026 **Time:** 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM (Registration starts at 1:30PM) **Location:** MRANTI Park *** ## ​🎯 Agenda ​1:30 – 2:00 PM \| Registration & Networking 2:00 – 2:10 PM \| AI Salon KL Organizer Opening Remarks 2:10 – 2:30 PM \| Parnters Opening Remarks 2:30 – 3:00 PM \| Community Startup / Builder Demos 3:00 – 4:00 PM \| Panel Session: AI Ethics & Financial Crime 4:00 – 5:00 PM \| Open Networking *** ## ​🎯 What to Expect ​✨ **AI Ethics & Governance** Hear from experts on how organizations are approaching responsible AI, governance, and ethical decision-making as AI becomes increasingly embedded in critical systems. ​🔐 **Financial Crime & Fraud** Explore how AI is enabling new forms of fraud, scams, and financial crime—and how financial institutions, regulators, and technology companies are responding. ​🚀 **Startup Builder Showcases** Discover startups and technical builders creating AI products and infrastructure across Southeast Asia. ​🤝 **High-Quality Networking** Connect with AI founders, engineers, researchers, compliance professionals, lawyers, enterprise leaders, operators, investors, and policymakers shaping Malaysia's AI ecosystem. ​💡 **Practical Conversations** Move beyond the headlines with real-world discussions on AI governance, regulation, security, ethics, and financial crime. ​🌐 **Global Community** Be part of a worldwide network of AI builders and communities spanning Miami, Dubai, Cairo, Kuala Lumpur, and beyond. *** ## ​🌐 About AI Salon ​AI Salon is a global community connecting AI founders, developers, researchers, and investors through city chapters around the world. ​From Miami to Dubai, Cairo to Kuala Lumpur, AI Salon creates spaces for practical conversations, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing around real-world AI innovation. *** ## ​🤝 Proudly Supported By ​\*\*[MRANTI](https://mranti.my/?utm_source=luma)\*\* (Community Partner) – Malaysia’s national technology and innovation hub, connecting researchers, startups, industry, government, and investors to accelerate technology development and innovation. ​\*\*[FPT AI Factory](https://factory.fpt.ai/?utm_source=luma)\*\* – A comprehensive AI Developer cloud platform offering end-to-end NVIDIA-accelerated computing infrastructure to support the complete AI product lifecycle. ​\*\*[Antler](https://www.antler.co/?utm_source=luma)\*\* – Global early-stage venture capital firm empowering exceptional founders. ​\*\*[Tsuin AI](https://tsuin.ai/?utm_source=luma)\*\* – AI startup building AI Twins that capture how engineers think and make decisions.
